LOWERING THERAPY

span.p:
CONDITIONAL if:
CKD stage 3+
urate >9 mg/dL
urolithiasis

span.p:
Treat flares only.
Do NOT treat
asymptomatic
hyperuricemia.

PROPHYLAXIS
3-6 MONTHS
while titrating:
colchicine 0.6 mg
(0.3 mg if
CrCl <30)

span.p:
1st LINE:
ALLOPURINOL
preferred in ALL,
including CKD

span.p:
Screen HLA-B*5801
FIRST if SE Asian
(Han Chinese,
Korean, Thai) or
African American

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
START LOW
100 mg daily
(50 mg if
CKD stage 3+)

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
TITRATE +100 mg
every 2-4 weeks
on serial urate
FDA MAX 800 mg

span.p:
Serum urate
<6.0 mg/dL?
(<5.0 if tophi)

span.p:
TARGET MET
Continue
INDEFINITELY
Recheck q6 months

Why did

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FEBUXOSTAT
40 up to 80 mg
BOXED WARNING:
CV death
avoid if CVD

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ADD PROBENECID
250 mg BID
up to 2 g/day
needs CrCl >50
no stones

div.style: color: rgb(76, 5, 25) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PEGLOTICASE
8 mg IV q2wk
+ METHOTREXATE
15 mg weekly
STOP oral ULT
Screen G6PD
Stop if urate >6
